units.source_text: 传右卫门激情澎湃的断定说，就像在说自己的事情一样。

en.t: Den'emon declared this with surging passion, as if he were speaking about his own affair.

units.source_text: 看他那个姿态，他自己很可能第一个去承担杀掉那些人的任务呢。

en.t: Judging from his posture, he seemed likely to be the first to take on the task of killing those men himself.

units.source_text: 在他的影响下，吉田、原、早水、堀部等人也都激昂起来，对那些乱臣贼子的痛骂又上升了一个新的层次。

en.t: Under his influence, Yoshida, Hara, Hayamizu, Horibe, and the others also grew fired up, and their denunciation of those traitorous rebels rose to a new pitch.

units.source_text: ——但是这其中只有石内藏助双手伏膝，一言不发的看着火盆。

en.t: But among them, only Oishi Kuranosuke sat with both hands on his knees, silently gazing at the brazier.
